## Relationships

### [Jane](../character/jane.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/inglis--jane.md)

Jane became Inglis's husband in Volume 3 after proposing to her a second time in [Hester](../character/hester-gray.md) Gray's garden. Inglis accepted the proposal, allowing the two to clear up past misunderstandings and share their mutual feelings before walking home engaged. Following this, the couple officially became husband and wife.
